title: Why the Strait of Hormuz Matters to Your Fuel Price
description:
About 20 million barrels a day, roughly a fifth of world oil use, passed through the Strait of Hormuz in 2024 (EIA), mostly to Asia. Pipelines can bypass only about 2.6 million barrels a day.
